name: All-Nighter Reading Glasses
body:
Price 4,000 gp; Slot eyes; CL 3rd; Weight –; Aura faint transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This pair of brass-framed reading glasses sit comfortably on the face, and seemingly make reading effortless. These glasses, a favorite of arcane researchers from a myriad of academies and universities, grant the user an extra reserve of mental fortitude when they are exhausted.

When worn as a magic item, the glasses grant the wearer low-light vision and immunity to magical sleep effects.

Furthermore, when the user has exhausted all of their highest level spells per day, they grant a +2 enhancement bonus to the DC and caster level of their spells cast, and a +3 enhancement bonus on saving throws against mind-affecting effects.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells keen senses
